aggregation: minimum of two valid ordinal 0/1/2 judgments; missing stays unavailable
summary_scope: WorkspaceBench interp-v1 text, one layer per call, only token strings and scores. No candidate ranks.
transport: OpenRouter; preserve catalog canonical versions and provider metadata; do not overwrite original judgments. Provider transport may differ from archived direct-API judgments.
primary_contrast: jsummary minus frozen jview at offset32, family-cluster CI for sensitivity AND FPR
claim_rule: Improved sensitivity alone is not improved detection if false positives rise; blind performance is not proof of necessity or novel nontextual content; shuffled similarity requires an equivalence margin, failure to reject difference is not equivalence.
engineering_amendment: 400-token initial validation-only transport pilot frequently exhausted budget on Gemini reasoning. Increased to 1600 uniformly before any reviewer scores or test calls; old raw responses retained but not used.
